full_judgment: (a) The suit land along with other lands originally belonged to Alimuddin who died leaving two sons, Enayetullah and Aminullah, and one daughter, Kahtun Bibi. That the said Alimuddin, during his lifetime, transferred 39 decimals of land to his son, Aminullah, by a registered deed, being No. 2906 dated 14-8-1939. That the said Aminullah sold out the same land by registered sale deed No. 2298 dated 09-5-1950 to the predecessor of the defendants, Asharab Ali, who thereafter transferred the said land to his two sons, Abdul Kadir (defendant No.1) and Sadir Mia by a registered heba deed, being No. 6718 dated 18-8-1952. On the other hand, it is stated, Anwar Ullah, son of SA recorded owner Aminullah, sold out 3(three) decimals of said the land to Abed All by registered deed No. 15195 dated 27-5-1974. Accordingly, RS khatian No. 3422, corresponding RS plot No. 18708 for land measuring 6(siX) decimals was prepared in his name. That he sold out 3(three) decimals of the said land by registered deed No. 2663 dated 20-4-1988 to AKM Azizur Rahman, Mrs Rozi Rahman, Mrs. Sufia Khatun, who subsequently sold out the same to the defendant No.1 by registered deed No. 3613 dated 19-8-1991.
